summary: Learn the best practices in monitoring and evaluation for sustainable energy projects. Enroll in our training to make a positive impact on clean energy.
lede: Monitoring and evaluation for clean energy projects links project goals with evidence about delivery and outcomes. Designed for professionals working on clean energy projects, this course covers building results chains, setting indicators and targets, and planning field data collection and verification. Participants also practice dashboard reporting, evaluation planning, and documenting social, environmental, and emissions evidence to support learning and project decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with clean energy projects and need sharper M&E systems, more credible reporting, and better evidence for decision-making.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of project delivery, program reporting, or energy operations. Prior exposure to M&E concepts is helpful but not mandatory; the course is pitched at intermediate to advanced level and assumes you can work with project indicators, basic Excel-based reporting, and structured program documentation. No programming is required for completion. If you already manage renewable energy, sustainability, climate, or infrastructure projects, you will benefit most when you bring a live project case, an existing results framework, or a sample indicator report for workshop exercises.
